grab3d.author: grab3d
grab3d.pivotMeaning: point on the floor between the feet

camera.iso: orthographic, true 2:1 isometric (dimetric), elevation 30 deg, azimuth 45 deg, same scale as Cozy Isometric Furniture Sprites

grab3d.directions: screen direction the character faces and walks: S faces the viewer, N faces away, SE/SW/NE/NW run along the 2:1 floor grid lines, E/W/N/S along the tile diagonals

figure.idle: single still frame made from the walk cycle (legs in rest pose), no breathing animation
